rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 4 cohorts from 2 universities (3 cohorts from University of Pittsburgh, 1 cohort from University of Pennsylvania), all using Siemens 3-T Tim Trio scanners but with different protocols
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Resting-state functional neuroimaging data from four samples (three cross-sectional, one longitudinal) were collected for 1,062 participants"; "Three data sets were acquired at the University of Pittsburgh and one at the University of Pennsylvania"; "The Luna 1, Luna 2, and Pitt cohorts were from the University of Pittsburgh, and the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort was from the University of Pennsylvania."
rci1_using_msad.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L33-L35; Table 1 footnote, L62

rci2_using_epd.detail: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) used as one of four cohorts for normative model construction; PNC data obtained via dbGaP
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Data for the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) was obtained through the Database of Genotypes and Phenotypes platform"
rci2_using_epd.location: appi.ajp.2018.18040443.ds001.pdf.md: Supplemental Methods / Participants / PNC, L12-L13

rci3_epd_name.detail: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC); 292 typically developing controls from PNC used in the normative model. The other 3 cohorts (Luna 1, Luna 2, Pitt) are in-house datasets from the University of Pittsburgh.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Data for the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) was obtained through the Database of Genotypes and Phenotypes platform"; Table 1 shows PNC contributing N=292 typically developing controls
rci3_epd_name.location: appi.ajp.2018.18040443.ds001.pdf.md: Supplemental Methods / PNC, L12; Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Table 1, L59

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase; all typically developing control youths used to construct normative growth charts (no explicit train/test split); pooled from 4 cohorts: Luna 1 (N=213), Luna 2 (N=88), PNC (N=292), Pitt (N=29)
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The final neuroimaging data set consisted of 1,062 participants 10-25 years old (typically developing control subjects, N=622; individuals with psychosis spectrum disorders, N=194; individuals with other psychopathology, N=246) from four different samples."
rci5_n.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L33-L35; Table 1, L57-L60

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; summed from Table 1 across 4 cohorts: Luna 1 (113M/100F), Luna 2 (45M/43F), PNC (151M/141F), Pitt (18M/11F)
rci6_sex.supporting_text: Table 1 Male/Female (N/N) for Typically Developing Group: Luna 1 "113/100", Luna 2 "45/43", Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort "151/141", Pitt "18/11"

rci7_age.detail: Overall phase; weighted mean and pooled SD computed from 4 cohorts: Luna 1 (N=213, mean=16.7, SD=3.0), Luna 2 (N=88, mean=19.5, SD=3.6), PNC (N=292, mean=16.2, SD=3.4), Pitt (N=29, mean=21.0, SD=2.7); age range 10-25 years
